text: DEFONEOS — MOJ Courts & Tribunals AI Deep-Dive Pack EU AI Act Article 50 live 2 Aug 2026 — C2PA passport ready | Get yours → Home Master GovBench Index Sitemap DEFONEOS × MOJ × HMCTS × Courts & Tribunals MOJ Courts & Tribunals AI Deep-Dive Pack Sovereign AI governance of UK MOJ courts and tribunals — HMCTS modernisation, digital court reform, jury service management, legal aid access, tribunal casework, court scheduling, evidence management, sentencing guidelines compliance, family court proceedings, judicial case management, court estate optimisation, and access to justice. 12 entry points × 8 transformation priorities × 6 MCPs. Audit-grade. Signed. UK-sovereign. 12 Entry Points 8 Transformation Priorities 6 MCP Servers 6 Red Lines 📋 12 Entry Points HMCTS HMCTS Reform — Common Platform, Digital Case System, Video Hearings HMCTS court modernisation programme — Common Platform for criminal case management. Digital Case System (DCS) — online case files, evidence upload, case progression. Video Hearings — Cloud Video Platform (CVP) for remote hearings. Online civil money claims — Money Claims Online (MCOL). Online divorce — Apply for divorce service. Probate online — digital grant applications. Social security tribunal — online appeals. Court finder — location and service availability. £1bn+ reform programme. Performance metrics — case timeliness, user satisfaction. Jury Jury Service — Summoning, Qualification, Digital Management Jury service management — juror summoning, qualification checks, deferral/exemption processing. Jury attendance — digital check-in, waiting room management. Juror information — case briefings, video evidence presentation. Jury deliberation — room allocation, facilities. Large/complex trial management — multi-site juries. Juror hardship — financial loss reimbursement. Digital jury management system. Juror diversity — representation analysis. Contempt/sequestration. Jury vetting — intelligence checks. Legal Aid Legal Aid — Access, Eligibility, Provider Contracts Legal aid framework — LASPO Act scope, exceptional case funding (ECF). Eligibility — income, capital, merits tests. Provider contracts — duty solicitor, family, housing, immigration, crime. Legal Aid Agency (LAA) administration — claims processing, cost assessment. Advice deserts — geographic coverage gaps. Community care legal aid. Mental health tribunal representation. Inquest legal aid. Means testing reform. Legal aid statistics — volumes, spend, outcomes. Tribunal Tribunal Casework — First-tier, Upper Tribunal, Specialist Tribunal system — First-tier Tribunal (8 chambers), Upper Tribunal. Immigration and Asylum Tribunal — case management, country guidance. Social Entitlement Chamber — benefits appeals, criminal injuries compensation. Tax Chamber — HMRC disputes, First-tier. Health, Education and Social Care Chamber — SEND, care standards. Employment Tribunal — unfair dismissal, discrimination. General Regulatory Chamber — information rights, gambling. Property Chamber — land registration, residential property. War Pensions and Armed Forces Compensation. Scheduling Court Scheduling — Case Listing, Judge Allocation, Room Management Court scheduling system — case listing, hearing allocation, judge/panel assignment. Room management — courtroom utilisation, capacity planning. Case timeliness targets — custody time limits, bail deadlines. Multi-track allocation — small claims, fast track, intermediate/multi. Listing policies — priority cases (domestic abuse, child custody, custody cases). Judiciary availability — part-time judges, recorder pool. Court sitting days — allocation and management. Digital listing — online case progression. Interpreter booking. Expert witness scheduling. Evidence Evidence Management — Disclosure, Digital Evidence, Exhibits Criminal disclosure — unused material schedule, third-party disclosure, prosecution/defence obligations. Digital evidence — body-worn video, CCTV, mobile phone extraction, cell site analysis. Evidence pr
